title: Investigate initial installed CLI smoke-test export loss
description:
During owner-approved live verification on 2026-10-31, first short Pi CLI synthetic session ca70 exited0 but emitted fixed degraded warning and persisted no records. Two subsequent fresh processes (ca71, ca72) passed, including unmodified installed package with no diagnostic extension. Cause unproven; tight100ms RPC/150ms processor deadlines and cold module loading are hypotheses only. See docs/live-verification.md. Reproduce at real enabled CLI boundary before changing timeouts/transport; preserve bounded natural shutdown and metadata privacy. Do not change services or installed package. Request fresh approval before more live writes; prefer independent loopback regression. No speculative production seam.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Investigate through a real enabled Pi CLI with an isolated synthetic provider and loopback receiver; distinguish cold-load, export deadline and transport behavior without assuming a cause.
- If reproduced, demonstrate an independently meaningful CLI-boundary regression failing before any fix and passing afterwards, without duplicating SDK-only coverage or adding test-only production seams.
- Preserve private official exporters, metadata privacy, fixed diagnostics, sticky loss and natural bounded shutdown; run ordered format/check/test gates for any code changes.
- If not reproduced, record bounded attempts and remaining uncertainty explicitly rather than claiming a diagnosis or changing timeout constants speculatively. Obtain separate approval before more live pipeline writes.
notes: Additional observation during metadata-expansion planning: no production/test changes, ordered make format/check passed; full make test had 1 integration failure in tools scenario at empty-stderr assertion (fixed degraded telemetry-loss diagnostic). Other26 integration +unit1 passed. Immediate focused rerun of tools file passed2/2. No cause established, no equivalence claimed with initial CLI failure, no timeout/service changes made.

title: Deliver granular metadata-only Pi operational and lifecycle telemetry
description:
## Scope and start
Authoritative implementation handoff for richer metadata-only Pi1.4.0 telemetry. Read all child descriptions; tracked docs/plans/granular-metadata-telemetry/spike-pi-events.md supplies API evidence. The duplicate tracked plan.md is intentionally removed; optional ignored local planning material is not required for implementation. Original design commit addec37a remains historical evidence.
Start with br show pi-opentelemetryroot-c79.1 and claim it. Children form a strict chain .1 -> .2 -> .3 -> .4 -> .5 -> .6 -> .7 -> .8; .8 needs fresh live-test approval even when dependencies clear. No implementation has begun.

## Release contract
An activity groups observed before_agent_start to final agent_settled, possibly many runs/turns; it is not a human prompt ID. Explicit trace hierarchy activity -> run -> turn -> model_call/tools with actual nested tool parents; pre-activity compaction is standalone. Opaque record IDs never metric labels.
Measure context-to-final-message observed model-call duration and first normalized output/text with source labels; not server/HTTP latency or universal TTFT. Keep final assistant messages sole delta token/cost owner, reasoning/cacheWrite1h nonadditive subsets, selected and physical model distinct. Replace old llm_request path without aliases/duplicate records.
Add compaction outcomes/timing, unambiguous UI waits, safe selected configuration, activation/replacement/input-source/resource-count observations. Missing/ambiguous data is omitted or covered explicitly, not invented.
Preserve bounds (32attrs/128chars,64 export queue, cardinality caps,1024 tools), opt-in/private local exporters, notification-only operation, sticky loss, trace-off correlation and natural cleanup. No content capture, arbitrary strings/headers/errors/paths/session names/history scanning.
No private hooks, fabricated retry/backoff/network attempt counts or generic other-extension execution timers. Do not register mcp_servers_change: it claims connector responsibility. Defer unsupported capabilities explicitly.

Each slice must work end to end in existing real-Pi fixture + decoded loopback receiver before proceeding. Follow test-audit, jj conventional task commits and ordered make format/check/test; package acceptance in.7; approved existing-viewer persisted-record verification in.8. No service restarts/config changes or independent active-DuckDB reads.
Issue pi-opentelemetryroot-bbt remains separate: planning full run had1 degraded-warning integration failure and focused rerun passed. Do not claim clean gates or silently change deadlines; diagnose reproducible blockers separately.
This epic closes only after all8 children accepted. ACK/exit0 is not persistence proof; pending approval remains an open final gate. No implementation or live-write authorization is implied by creating these beads.

title: V1: Implement activity and turn correlation through final settlement
description:
## Outcome
A user can expand one observed activity into low-level runs and turns, with live start logs and exactly-once final settlement. An activity is not claimed to be one human prompt.

## Implementation
- Begin a bounded activity at before_agent_start using only messageType=user|custom and a random pi.activity.id. Close at agent_settled, not agent_end. Record final aborted separately from had_error; settlement is not proof of task success.
- Keep existing run IDs/outcomes and add unique pi.turn.id plus numeric run-local turnIndex. Turn indexes reset at each run. Explicit hierarchy: activity -> run -> turn -> existing assistant observation/tools; nested tool spans still use actual parent tool IDs, including composite pipe IDs.
- Emit activity_start/end and turn_start/end logs and corresponding count/duration instruments (seconds, bounded enums). Carry applicable activity/run/turn/request/session IDs on records only, never metric labels.
- Define incomplete/terminal-only/repeated-start behavior before tests. Shutdown, reload and replacement close open owners once without invented successful durations, usage or stale parent IDs. Standalone events get explicit scope rather than the last completed parent.
- Extract correlation state from growing src/session.ts only as needed. Keep src/index.ts small and src/telemetry.ts the private exporter owner. No framework or broad unrelated refactor.
- Produce per-record attribute budgets within 32 attributes and 128-character limits, preserving required IDs/outcomes before optional data; bound all new active state and instrument labels. Keep existing request schema until V2 replaces it end to end.

## Proof
Extend actual SDK fixture scenarios for multiple turns, additional low-level runs, agent_before_settle continuation, custom trigger, steering/follow-up, abort and reload/new/resume/fork. Fixture may request continuation; telemetry itself must not. Assert exact ownership/parentage, index resets, no premature activity end at agent_end, no one-prompt attribution, no stale IDs, trace-off operation, usage unchanged and incomplete cleanup. Extend privacy sentinels and decoded receiver assertions. Verify rapid-turn admission behavior rather than silently enlarging queues.

title: V2 spike: Prove model timing boundaries and provider-hook correlation
description:
## Outcome
Resolve the conditional provider-phase design before production hooks are enabled. A documented negative result is valid: core model timing must still ship without invented correlation.

## Investigation

These hooks have no public request ID. Include missing/duplicate hooks, setup error, abort, virtual routing and unrelated direct work.
- Decide which associations can be proved safe. Never attach to whichever request is current by assumption, read header/payload values, count callbacks as network attempts or access SDK/private internals.
- If claiming built-in provider HTTP behavior, exercise that built-in provider against an isolated local HTTP server with no credentials or paid calls. Synthetic callbacks alone prove forwarding, not built-in retry/transport semantics.

title: V2: Implement honest model-call timing and final metadata accounting
description:
## Outcome
Replace stream-only request claims with accurately named logical model-call observations, first-output/text latency and richer safe response metadata.

## Implementation
- Consume the completed V2 spike decision; do not enable correlated provider fields if it could not prove safe association.
- Start pi.model_call at context using a monotonic baseline without traversing messages. Complete on final assistant message_end. Includes later transforms/routing/auth/provider/streaming work, not exclusive HTTP/server time. Generate one pi.request.id per logical observation.
- Replace obsolete pi.llm_request span/log path with pi.model_call span and pi.model_call_end summary. Remove duplicate/compatibility emissions, update applicable tests/docs/examples together; leave old stored records untouched.
- Keep first normalized output and first text timestamps separately. Inspect only discriminants and delta length; no content storage. Empty block starts and stream start are not first tokens. Toolcall_start means structured output began. Missing values are omitted, never zero; label sources.
- Preserve separate assistant-lifecycle interval and valid SDK durationMs with distinct source semantics. A setup error may synthesize message_start/end; do not manufacture streaming/first-output timing from it.
- Repeated context interrupts prior observation as incomplete; close missing terminals on turn/run/disposal without invented usage. Missing provider support alone is not assistant-observation loss.
- Final metadata: bounded physical provider/model/api, response identifiers/model, stop reason, effective thinkingLevel/providerThinkingLevel. ctx.model is selected configuration and can differ under virtual routing.
- Final assistant message_end remains sole token/cost owner. Keep delta totals unchanged. Add reasoning and cacheWrite1h as explicitly nonadditive log subsets, optional valid cost components as log breakdowns. No extra additive token types; no unproved five-minute cache bucket. Missing/invalid data stays unknown.
- Add model-call count/duration, first-output/text histograms and fixed-reason coverage counts with bounded labels, no operation IDs/status codes in metric labels. Enforce 32-field budgets. No per-delta or raw provider event export.

## Proof
Use real SDK fixture from spike: delayed setup, text/thinking/tool-only, empty/no milestones, error/abort/pending/deferred, repeated/missing terminals, virtual physical model, valid/invalid subset values, trace-off and shutdown. Assert intervals and one usage contribution against independent expected values. Privacy sentinel every newly reachable field; no content in any decoded signal.

title: V3a: Capture compaction intervals and terminal outcomes
description:
## Outcome
Manual, threshold and overflow compaction become named operations with truthful placement, reason and outcome, without expanding billing coverage.

## Implementation
- Pair session_before_compact with session_compact or session_compact_failed using one bounded pending compaction owner and an opaque operation ID.
- Emit compaction start/end logs, span, count and duration by fixed reason/outcome (seconds). Select activity parent only if actually active; between-run recovery belongs to activity, pre-prompt/manual idle compaction is session-correlated standalone root. Do not fabricate an activity parent before before_agent_start.
- Retain only reason, willRetry, fromExtension, aborted and validated numeric tokensBefore. willRetry describes observed recovery intent, not confirmed network retry or eventual resumed success.
- Failures can arrive without a before event (e.g. manual preparation failure): record terminal outcome without fabricated start/span/duration. Cancellation must use public aborted flag, never error text.
- Handle duplicate/replaced starts and shutdown as incomplete once. Do not mutate cancel/custom compaction return values or inspect summaries, branch entries, previous summary, details, custom instructions/file ops.
- Do not add compactionEntry.usage to assistant-only token/cost counters. Latency coverage must not silently become full-session spending.
- Attribute/state/metric limits remain unchanged; omit unavailable values rather than invent after-token estimates.

## Proof
Drive real Pi manual/threshold/overflow flows with isolated synthetic provider or actual extension-provided compaction fixture. Include success, provider error, extension cancellation, abort, terminal-without-start, pre-activity and between-run recovery, shutdown and trace-off. Assert correct ancestry and matching outcome/duration counts; no zero-duration false success, no double closure/usage. Place privacy sentinels in summary/instructions/details/errors and all preparation content.

title: V3b: Measure blocking UI waits without ambiguous prompt pairing
description:
## Outcome
Blocking extension UI time is visible without leaking dialog text or pretending overlapping waits can always be identified.

## Implementation
- Observe ui_prompt_start/end, retaining fixed kind only; discard title entirely. Emit ui_wait start/end logs, interval spans and seconds histogram by kind.
- No public prompt ID exists. Pair only unambiguous intervals, including nested different-kind prompts. Concurrent same-kind starts render corresponding intervals ambiguous: do not choose arbitrary FIFO/LIFO, finish guessed spans or manufacture durations. Specify a bounded ambiguity/drain state until pairing becomes safe again.
- Bound tracking (plan proposes at most16 open waits); overflow/unmatched events get fixed coverage/loss behavior, not unbounded state or raw event records. Separate capability ambiguity from confirmed local data loss.
- Parent to the real active operation where justified and preserve correlation in trace-off. UI wait can overlap model/tool/activity intervals; document inclusiveness, never sum into total elapsed time as an exclusive phase.
- Finish unambiguous open intervals incomplete once on reload/abort/disposal. Observer must not show a dialog, consume user input or change approval decisions. Do not inspect titles, returned user text or UI arguments.
- Guard TUI/RPC support as documented; do not assume a terminal UI exists in print/JSON mode.

## Proof
Use real Pi UI prompt lifecycle with controllable noninteractive test UI. Test single wait, nested different kinds, overlapping same kind, unmatched end, overflow, cancellation and shutdown; avoid a test that simply calls telemetry handlers with invented order. Assert only safe intervals measured, no false outcome/parentage, bounded state and no dialog mutation. Put content sentinel in titles and prompt/result values; verify exclusion from logs/spans/metrics and trace-off behavior.

title: V4: Add safe configuration, input and runtime-resource observations
description:
## Outcome
Operators can see selected configuration and runtime transitions without content capture or invented plugin/connection measurements.

## Implementation
- Enrich session_start/end with fixed reason enum (startup/reload/new/resume/fork/quit as applicable), mode and safe versions. Counts remain activation counts, not unique historical sessions.
- Record input_received with source and optional streamingBehavior only. Input may be transformed/handled/queued by other extensions: no accepted-prompt counter, prompt ID, text/image inspection or FIFO attribution to activities.
- model_select and thinking_level_select logs contain bounded selected provider/model, source and old/new level enums. Snapshot selection at activity start; distinguish selected/virtual config from final physical model metadata owned by V2.
- resources_discover records startup/reload and public getter counts for registered/active tools and registered MCP servers, only the snapshot at this handler. Do not read/export descriptions, names/server configs/paths; do not claim final discovery, plugin loading, connectivity or health. Return no resource paths.
- NEVER register mcp_servers_change: that claims connector responsibility. No generic plugin/hook timing exists; no monkeypatching or private access to invent it.
- Log session_before_switch/fork/tree as requested observations and session_tree as observed navigation; retain kind and summary-requested/present booleans only. Cancellable before hooks lack universal terminals: no successful navigation/replacement or duration inferred solely from request. Actual shutdown/start reasons confirm completed replacements.
- No session_info_changed name values, previous/target file paths, entry summaries, working directory or task classification. Avoid stale parent IDs in idle events.
- Respect extension handler ordering: observed mutable values/proposals are not necessarily final after later handlers.

## Proof
Real SDK runtime reload/new/resume/fork/navigation and cancelled before-hooks, input consumed/transformed by another fixture extension, model/thinking selection including virtual routing, resources getter observations. Compare fixture behavior with/without observer: outcomes, continuation and returned resource paths unchanged; MCP responsibility not stolen. Sentinels in prompts/names/paths/titles/descriptions/server config/summary stay absent; trace-off and state limits hold.
